objective: Round 3 Phase 2: GitHub Integration — Ingest GitHub repository commits, pull requests, issues, and documentation into structured sources, extract knowledge findings using Gemini 2.5 Flash, and attach clickable GitHub evidence citations with commit SHAs and deep file line coordinates.
acceptance_criteria: Database migration for github_integrations and github_webhook_events tables with RLS enabled
Strongly typed GitHub domain models and provenance structures in src/lib/types.ts
Secure backend GitHub service (backend/services/github.ts) supporting RS256 App JWTs, proactive token caching (<5m refresh), rate-limit defense, pagination, and error normalization
Storage repository interface extended with GitHub integration methods and implemented in DurableFileRepository and SupabaseStorageRepository
Zero credential leakage with automatic redaction of secret tokens in error messages and exceptions
Comprehensive automated test suite in src/__tests__/githubIntegration.test.mjs covering all 10 security and service scenarios
All 161 baseline tests continue passing without regression (172 total tests passing)
Clean production builds for both Express backend and Next.js frontend
non_goals: Do not implement Milestone 2.3 through 2.8 before user approval
Do not implement Phase 3 continuous update drift scanner during Phase 2
Do not expose GitHub App private keys or installation tokens to client bundles
Do not weaken database RLS policies

verification.command: npm test && npm run backend:build && npm run frontend:build
verification.result: 172 of 172 automated tests passed across all 11 test suites (Phase 2 GitHub Service: 11 tests, Phase 1 Role Security: 11 tests, Phase D: 15 tests, Phase I: 20 tests, Phase E: 23 tests, Phase F: 16 tests, Persistence: 9 tests, Phase C: 13 tests, Phase H Supabase: 18 tests, Handover Generation/Integrity: 36 tests). Standalone Express backend compiles to dist/backend/server.js (213.1 KB) in 10ms. Frontend compiles to Next.js production bundle with 0 errors across all routes.
